verdict.rationale: Notte documents generating workflow code from agent or CLI runs ("Generate it with the CLI first, then edit it", MCP can "build scripts"). That code can then be deployed as serverless functions, and the GitHub README pitches scripting deterministic parts and using AI only when needed, "cutting costs by 50%+". This amounts to replaying generated code instead of re-prompting, but there is no documented automatic action cache or replay mechanism. Missing for 10: an explicit cache of resolved actions or selectors with automatic replay, documented cache invalidation or self-healing on cache misses, and independent corroboration of the cost and latency savings.
